sentences.text: we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat important words. Today, we travel
to Eastern Europe. We go to Romania. Our city today is Sibiu. Sibiu is calm. Sibiu
is historic. Sibiu is full of old streets and stories. Please relax. Please listen
slowly. Let's begin our journey. Part 2, Romania and Europe. Romania is a country in
Europe. It is in the east of Europe. Romania has mountains. Romania has forests.
Romania has old towns. Many people know Bucharest, but today we visit Sibiu. Sibiu is
smaller. Sibiu is very charming. Part 3, where is Sibiu? Sibiu is in the center of
Romania. It is in the region of Transylvania. The city is near the Carpathian mountains.
Nature is close. The air feels fresh. The land feels green. Sibiu feels peaceful and
safe. Part 4, weather and seasons. Sibiu has four seasons. Spring is fresh and bright.
Summer is warm. Autumn is colorful. Leaves fall from trees. Winter is cold.
Snow covers the roofs. Each season changes the city's mood. Part 5, a city with long
history. Sibiu has a long history. People lived here many centuries ago. The city was
important for trade. Different cultures lived together. German culture was strong here.
Romanian culture is also strong. History is in the streets. History is in the walls.
Part 6, the Old Town. The Old Town of Sibiu is beautiful. It has small streets. Buildings are
colorful. Roofs look like eyes. People walk slowly. They look around. The Old Town feels
alive. It feels friendly. Part 7, main squares. Sibiu has two main squares. They are very important.
People meet here. They talk and relax. There are cafes and museums. Life feels social. The
daily life in Sibiu is calm. People work and study. In the morning, streets are quiet.
In the evening, streets are full. People enjoy walking. People enjoy simple moments. Life
is balanced and slow. Part 9, food and traditions. Food and Sibiu is traditional. People eat
soup and meat. Bread is important. Meals are warm. Families eat together. Traditions are strong.
Food brings comfort and joy. Ash part 10, culture and festivals. Sibiu loves culture. There are
festivals. Music fills the streets. The city feels alive. People celebrate art and theater.
Culture brings people together. Festivals bring color and energy. Part 11, nature around
the city. Nature is close to Sibiu. There are hills and forests. People go outside the city.
They walk and rest. Nature brings silence. Nature brings peace. Life feels connected to land.
